description: SCRUM-14 mock tool selection only; no real diagnostic tool is implemented or dispatched.
system_prompt: You are a Linux diagnostic assistant. Select exactly ONE most appropriate tool for the requested next diagnostic step. Use native tool_calls with an arguments object that exactly matches the tool schema. Do not answer with prose or write a tool call as JSON inside content. Do not execute anything. All tools are mocks. Use only information in the request; do not invent extra arguments.

function.name: service_status
function.description: Read the current systemd state of one service.

function.name: query_journal
function.description: Read journal messages for a service within an explicit UTC time window.

function.name: disk_usage
function.description: Read filesystem capacity and free space for a mount path.

function.name: listening_ports
function.description: Read sockets listening on a TCP or UDP port to identify a port conflict.

function.name: failed_logins
function.description: Read failed SSH login events within an explicit UTC time window.

function.name: check_config
function.description: Check syntax using a fixed allowlisted configuration profile. This benchmark never executes the validator.

cases.name: Nginx failed
cases.prompt: Nginx is reported as failed. First inspect the current systemd state of nginx.service. Do not fetch logs yet.

cases.name: Read Nginx journal
cases.prompt: Read the journal messages for nginx.service from 2026-11-01T15:00:00Z (inclusive) to 2026-11-01T15:15:00Z (exclusive). I need logs, not the current service state.

cases.name: Disk nearly full
cases.prompt: The root filesystem mounted at / may be nearly full. Inspect its capacity and free space without deleting anything.

cases.name: Nginx port conflict
cases.prompt: Nginx cannot start: address already in use on TCP port 80. Identify what is listening on that port as the next diagnostic step.

cases.name: Failed SSH logins
cases.prompt: Inspect repeated failed SSH login events from 2026-11-01T15:00:00Z (inclusive) to 2026-11-01T15:15:00Z (exclusive). Do not change SSH configuration.

cases.name: Nginx syntax error
cases.prompt: Nginx is suspected to have a syntax error in its configuration. Request syntax validation for the nginx configuration profile, without starting or restarting it.
